purpose: Every day a SHORTLIST (3–5) of fresh, quality-gated items (repo, benchmark, model, paper), each with a ready-to-paste text and Henry’s pick, sent to Martin in Buzz to start a conversation; Martin chooses and posts to WhatsApp himself.

inputs.what: X (browser), arXiv, mainstream media, a little Reddit — vetted sources only
what was already shared; what Martin and attendees liked

steps.do: Find candidate items of the last 24–48 h
Score with the quality-gate rubric; drop wrapper-funding and stale items; keep the top 3–5 not shared before; mark Henry’s pick
Write a short ready-to-paste text per item (approximation style, link)
Send to Martin in Buzz main; remember it in the brain

outputs: Buzz message to Martin: shortlist with Henry’s pick + texts
done_when: review verdict pass for every listed item
no item shared in the last 30 days
Martin’s choice (or no reply) recorded in the brain

approvals.notes: Martin posts to WhatsApp himself; Henry only messages Martin.

escalation.when: fewer than 3 items score ≥ 3: send what there is and say so
